notes: All four sources remain unchanged and were reconciled individually to approved output files. Folded pink/blue construction reconstructed using this same folder's unfolded references.

The description's 38 inches is retained as authoritative length metadata; accepted generated hems are visually below knee. Physical inches cannot be measured or certified from a synthetic image without a calibrated scale/model measurement.

Visual QA covers visible color, neckline embroidery, paired straps, three reflective centers, silhouette, drape, whole-garment visibility, anatomy and scene. It is not a pixel-exact textile or calibrated-color certification.

Main and blue share a safe near-front stance but have different head/gaze direction. Pink uses a crossed forward foot below hem and angled torso; coral has uncrossed staggered feet and relaxed arms. Larger turns were limited to keep all neckline details visible.

Four longer-hem candidates rejected; two main corrections were service-blocked in this run. Final main generated using corrected same-product blue hem reference. Only the four approved images copied into generated/. Earlier failed attempts retained as historical records.
Unseen back construction and fiber composition remain unverified. Native size is below preferred 4K.
conclusion: COMPLETE against visible-reference workflow criteria: one accepted main and three accepted color images, full garment visibility, consistent scene and subtle pose variety. Physical garment length remains metadata rather than a calibrated image measurement.
